item.tib: skyabs gnas spyi 'dus kyi rtsa sgrub bla ma mchod pa'i phyag bzhes gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: zhes phyag bzhes gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di yang / snod ldan slob ma rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ khyung dkar sprang 'khyams grub ming 'bod pa yis chu mo glang lo'i yar tshes dge ba'i nyin/ sbas yul bde skyid gling zhes bya ba/ zhang zhung yul gyi lho shar/ rgya gar yul gyi byang nub/ bod yul dbus kyi nub phyogs/ lho dom sgro nag po snyug ma bu khur gyi yul/ stang chen ya ngal mtha' bzhi tre ston sogs gdung rgyud che bzhi'i gdan sa/ mtsho dgon g.yung drung bde ldan gling du gang dran bris pa bkra shis su gyur cig/
